notes.notes:
[h3][b]STEAM SUMMER SALE[/b][/h3]
🌊🏖🌴Jump into some refreshingly cool savings during the Steam Summer Sale, like 70% off the adorable but challenging action-RPG, Gurumin: A Monstrous Adventure! This is the deepest discount Gurumin has ever seen on Steam, so don't miss out on this fantastic opportunity!

If shooters and warm tropical nights are more your thing, then things are really gonna' heat up when you see that the Heavy Fire + Reload Triple Pack is 75% off! 💥

https://store.steampowered.com/app/322290/Gurumin_A_Monstrous_Adventure/
 
https://store.steampowered.com/sub/80562/

Check out the brand new [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/mastiff/]Mastiff Publisher Page[/url][/b] right here on Steam for all of the tasty deals going down right now through July 8.

And please be sure to follow us on Steam and on your favorite social media platforms for the latest news, deals, and giveaways! 😏🎁

PROTIP: Follow us on the the [url=https://twitter.com/mastiffgames/]Mastiff Twitter[/url] account today for giveaways going down TODAY and TOMORROW!

We recently announced that we'll be working with MeNic Games to publish their toy city-builder Tinytopia! 🏗🏨🏙

The game is a 'toy-tal' blast to play! (OK, that pun didn't really work, did it? Well, we tried. 😅)
Please check out the Tinytopia Steam store page and add it to your Wishlist today!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/968550/Tinytopia/

notes.title: Lunar New Year Sale & Your Chance to WIN a $25 Gift Card!
notes.notes:
[b]Happy Lunar Near Year, everyone![/b] :lunar2019wavingpig:

We hope that everyone has been having a wonderful year thus far, and that your holidays were filled with fun and cheer! 

We may be a little late to making this here sale announcement, but let's instead consider the sale news to be arriving fashionably late. Yeah, that sounds good...let's roll with that. 

[h1][b]Steam Lunar New Year Sale:[/b][/h1]
Aside from being able to pick up [i]Gurumin[/i] for a steal-of-a-deal price (65% off), we also have a few other titles on sale too...like the on-rails action-shooter series, Heavy Fire. Right now both [i]Heavy Fire: Shattered Spear[/i] and [i]Heavy Fire: Afghanistan[/i] are on sale during the Lunar New Year Sale. The shooting sim, [i]Reload[/i] is also on sale too. It's a game that you can find yourself playing for hours and not even realize it. It's strangely satisfying. But don't just take our word for it. If you enjoy colorful action-RPGs or arcade-style action shooters, definitely don't miss out on any of these titles while the sale is still live!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/305980/Heavy_Fire_Afghanistan/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/305980/Heavy_Fire_Afghanistan/[/url]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/385600/Heavy_Fire_Shattered_Spear/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/385600/Heavy_Fire_Shattered_Spear/[/url]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/330370/Reload/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/330370/Reload/[/url]

[b]PICK UP ALL THREE IN THE HEAVY FIRE + RELOAD TRIPLE PACK!
[/b]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/sub/80562/]https://store.steampowered.com/sub/80562/[/url]

Plus, during the Steam Lunar New Year Sale, qualifying purchases over $30.00 will receive an automatic discount of $5.00! How cool is that?! Thank you, Steam! :lunar2019smilingpig:

[h1][b]WIN A $25 AMAZON GIFT CARD ON US![/b][/h1]
Yup! We're giving our fans a chance to win a $25 Amazon gift card by participating in the Mastiff 2019 Customer Survey! Click the image below to start the survey and help us continue to deliver the best possible service and the best games at the best prices in 2019 and beyond!

[url=https://www.surveymonkey.com/r/mastiff2019survey][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7923016/bacd020db6c4fe47dcc6f3d286e8516a0a908521.png[/img][/url]

We love to hear from you! So if you're on [url=http://facebook.com/mastiffgames/]Facebook[/url] or [url=http://twitter.com/mastiffgames/]Twitter[/url], please don't hesitate to give us a shout. 

Well, that about wraps it up for now. 
Thank you for all of your support, and keep being awesome!

It's the most wonderful time of the year! 
That's right, it's time again for the Steam Winter Sale! 

From now through January 2, 2017 you can save on the critically-acclaimed action-RPG, [b]Gurumin: A Monstrous Adventure[/b] and other high-action titles from Mastiff like [b]Heavy Fire: Shattered Spear[/b], [b]Heavy Fire: Afghanistan[/b], and [b]Reload[/b], which was recently used in a [url=http://journals.sagepub.com/doi/abs/10.1177/0956797615579274]case study[/url] published by the Association for Psychological Science on how "Cognitive Training Can Reduce Civilian Casualties in a Simulated Shooting Environment." Thanks for all of your support. 

[b]Happy Holidays & Happy New Year. We'll see you in 2017!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7923016/f8d7d82894f69fdb8c5a6099fc0aca1543169bd1.png[/img]

It's the most wonderful time of the year! 
That's right, it's time again for the Steam Winter Sale! 

From now through January 2, 2017 you can save on the critically-acclaimed action-RPG, [b]Gurumin: A Monstrous Adventure[/b] and other high-action titles from Mastiff like [b]Heavy Fire: Shattered Spear[/b], [b]Heavy Fire: Afghanistan[/b], and [b]Reload[/b], which was recently used in a [url=http://journals.sagepub.com/doi/abs/10.1177/0956797615579274]case study[/url] published by the Association for Psychological Science on how "Cognitive Training Can Reduce Civilian Casualties in a Simulated Shooting Environment." It's quite an interesting and insightful read -- we highly suggest checking it out when you get a few minutes to spare.

You can also pick up all three shooters in the [b][url=http://store.steampowered.com/sub/80562/]Heavy Fire + Reload Triple Pack[/url][/b] at an even bigger discount!

Get in on the savings!
http://store.steampowered.com/app/322290/
http://store.steampowered.com/app/385600/
http://store.steampowered.com/app/305980/
http://store.steampowered.com/app/330370/


And if you're looking for RPG action on the go, Gurumin is now available around the world in the Nintendo eShop for the 3DS! You can purchase it directly from your 3DS or from  [url=http://www.nintendo.com/games/detail/gurumin-3d-a-monstrous-adventure-3ds]HERE[/url]! 

Check out what press have been saying about Gurumin 3D:

[url=https://twitter.com/Gurumin3D/status/811366563756421120][img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7923016/719e2e3ef439e85e50b22209d6bd3f4d44f69740.png[/img][/url]

We also have several themes available in the Theme Shop that you can use to decorate your 3DS with. Each theme features unique art, game folders, and music straight from the game!

So if you've been good all year long why not treat yourself to some gaming goodness? Go on, you've earned it! And perhaps you're looking for a last minute gift for a friend too. Well, they do make for great digital stocking stuffers - consider sharing the joy by gifting any one of these titles to a friend!

Thanks for all of your support. 

[b]Happy Holidays & Happy New Year. We'll see you in 2017!

-Mastiff[/b]

notes.title: Gurumin 3D Returns from PAX West with photos, launch price, 3DS themes, and more!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7923016/c603bd93b047dc98a239fb70ed32bd8cecc1ebad.jpg[/img]

Greetings all, 

It's been a few weeks since we've returned from PAX West and it's also been a good while since we've posted a news update on Steam, so we thought that we would break that silence with some awesome news regarding the upcoming Nintendo 3DS eShop release of [i]Gurumin 3D: A Monstrous Adventure[/i]. 

That said - and we'll keep this short and sweet - we now have a price for [i]Gurumin 3D[/i]. The game will be released very soon on the Nintendo 3DS eShop for the shortcake-sweet price of $14.99. And shortly after launch (most likely the following week) we will also be releasing multiple themes on the 3DS Theme Shop that you can use to decorate your 3DS with. As an added bonus, the theme depicted below ("Gurumin Party Time Theme") will be free with purchase for a limited time! 😉

Here's a preview image of the "Gurumin Party Time Theme":
[url=http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7923016/51e11d688c4b2b2d6df7ccac907373668395a809.jpg][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7923016/0c84011aa480837e5dd9b8f0d52e3ab165d3a310.jpg[/img][/url]

More information, including some images from PAX West, and preview images featuring the other 3DS themes can be found in our latest news blog entry on [url=http://gurumin.rocks/gurumin-3d-completes-its-quest-at-pax-west-returns-with-photos-launch-price-3ds-themes-and-more/]www.Gurumin.Rocks/[/url].

Please check out all of the themes and let us know your favorite by leaving a comment here or by chatting with us on our social media pages:

Twitter: [url=www.twitter.com/Gurumin3D]www.twitter.com/Gurumin3D[/url]
Facebook: [url=www.facebook.com/Gurumin3D]www.facebook.com/Gurumin3D[/url]

Keep drilling,
Mastiff

notes.title: Gurumin Joins the Steam Summer Sale, Parin and Friends Headed to 3DS Later This Summer!
notes.notes:
Gurumin Joins the Steam Summer Sale, Parin and Friends Headed to 3DS Later This Summer!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7923016/a5a6f8d70ca794e84b7d46f0f89c05df3251dc36.png[/img]

For everyone who's been sitting on the fence: now is the time to pick up [i]Gurumin: A Monstrous Adventure[/i]. During the Steam Summer Sale, which will be running through July 4th at 10:00am PST, you can purchase Gurumin at 52% off the normal price!

Also, if you didn't catch the news last week, Gurumin is coming to the Nintendo 3DS eShop later this summer as [i]Gurumin 3D: A Monstrous Adventure[/i]. All the Gurumin goodness you love but remastered in beautiful stereoscopic 3D and completely portable! As an added bonus, the 3DS version will offer increased camera control, more convenient access to inventory, equipment, parts, the menu and, maybe best of all, an in-game help function.

You can drill up additional information about the story, characters, in-game items, view blog posts, and more by visiting the official Gurumin 3D: A Monstrous Adventure website at [url=www.Gurumin.Rocks]www.Gurumin.Rocks[/url]. We can't wait to share more news with you soon, so be sure to follow the game on Twitter at [url=https://twitter.com/Gurumin3D]twitter.com/Gurumin3D[/url] and Like us on Facebook at [url=https://www.facebook.com/Gurumin3D]facebook.com/Gurumin3D[/url].

Also, if you belong to a video game editorial website, or are a Twitch or YouTube content creator, please check out the Contact section of the Gurumin.Rocks site to learn how you may be eligible for a review key on Steam or for 3DS (upon availability later this summer): [url=http://gurumin.rocks/contact/]http://gurumin.rocks/contact/[/url]

notes.title: Gamepad Right Stick Camera Control and More!
notes.notes:
It's been another busy week here at the Mastiff Global Command and Control Doghouse. We'd much prefer to be chasing the neighbor's cat, napping and digging up long buried bones, but you guys have kept us busy stomping bugs and adding features. 

[U] Control Camera with Gamepad Right Stick [/U]

By popular demand, it's here! To implement -

[olist]
 [*]Open the "Gamepad" tab at the configuration screen and hit the "SET" button next to the input you want to set-up for. 
 [*]Press a button or move a stick on your gamepad. That button/stick will then be registered to the input you choose above in step 1. 
 [*]Make sure all inputs are set. If you see "----------------", it means that an input is not set or you've tried to assign the same function to two different controls. 
[/olist]
If you are using an Xbox 360 gamepad, we suggest setting up "Camera: Show Left" for "Right Stick X Left" and "Camera: Show Right" for "Right Stick X Right". 


[u] Other Stuff [/u]
[list]
 [*]Maid Outfit: No longer disappears after being properly obtained
 [*]Headband: No longer disappears after being properly obtained
 [*]Pierre's conversation: Text corrected
 [*]Force Feedback: Bug that stopped this feature from working on many newer gamepads fixed

notes.title: WASD Added, Improved Gamepad Control, Other Dev Updates
notes.notes:
It's been an extremely busy few days here at the Mastiff doghouse. 

[b]WASD Support Added[/b]
Just go to the Keyboard And Mouse tab and select WASD from the drop down menus for the appropriate directions. We couldn't add the letters W and S alphabetically without breaking already set up custom configurations, so they are at the bottom of the list.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/Ieil6GW.jpg[/img]
[img]http://i.imgur.com/hAhAUMZ.jpg[/img]

[b]Improved Gamepad Control[/b]
As many of you have requested, we've increased the dead zone, going from 8.6% to 11.7%. This should help with the drift issue. We also ask everyone to make sure that drivers for any controllers are installed and up to date. 

[b]Item Unlock Bug[/b]
If you downloaded the game after 3:00am on March 31 then you are not affected by this. If you got your game in the first sixteen hours of its release then you experienced a bug in save data creation that  incorrectly unlocked the item list, difficulty modes, costume and a hidden character. 

We've released an updated version that mostly fixes the above problem. We say "mostly" because two small problems remain

[list]
[*] It's still theoretically possible (though very unlikely) a user could experience an issue with the Maid Outfit where the outfit is unlocked even though unlock on it was not earned, or vice versa.

[*] The item list, now correctly viewable after Normal or Beginner mode is cleared, may incorrectly display an item’s status (locked or unlocked). Only the list is wrong - the item is correctly handled in the game, and gameplay, unlockables, achievements and rankings are not affected in any way. It’s only an issue in that some perfectionist players (what some might call cho-otaku) may want to see a display showing they have every item. 
[/list]

We are working on a fix for the two above issues, and if we can’t come up with a perfect fix will also offer players the extreme option of zeroing out their inventory and starting over. Of course, this is only something we'd only expect the hardest of the hardcore to even think about doing. 

We'd like to thank all of you for your support and understanding. We are a small company that put a lot into Gurumin and it's been a source of great pleasure watching the community embrace this game.

notes.title: Gurumin: A Monstrous Adventure Comes Our Way
notes.notes:
Just the other day I was talking about another action-RPG from Japanese developers Nihon Falcom coming our way (Ys VI, there), when lawks a lummy look! Another one’s already here, as an English translation of Gurumin: A Monstrous Adventure [official site] launched yesterday.

It’s a cutesy adventure about a girl, her monster friends (who are invisible to adults, obvs), and her magical drill. Together, they fight evil spirits and save the village. Adventure! It looks all cutey-cute, but I have heard some fairly good things about the old PSP port.

… [visit site to read more]

notes.title: Greenlight Supporters! Your Free Codes Are Ready
notes.notes:
Happy Launch Day, everyone!

We at Mastiff understand that there may have been some confusion regarding the instructions and steps required to be elegible for a free Gurumin: A Monstrous Adventure Steam key.

When we announced the Gurumin: A Monstrous Adventure greenlight campaign we [url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/updates/286828342/?p=2] promised [/url] a free code to everyone who voted for us, registered in the Gurumin group, and posted to let us know they had voted. But in the Gurumin group itself our instructions weren't clear. That left some users concerned that they wouldn't be receiving their free key.

We want to make sure that everyone is happy. So... We are awarding a key to EVERYONE who helped us get Gurumin through Steam Greenlight and ALSO to registered users who joined the Gurumin Steam group up through last week! This means that we are tossing the comment part out the window. We would rather give away a few extra keys to those of you who supported us than leave legitimate supporters who just failed to post empty-handed.

How awesome is that?! 
Consider it a token of our gratitude!  


To get your Gurumin Steam key, proceed to the following URL:

http://top3line.com/gurumin_steam_codes/

From the redemption page, click on the icon that says "Sign in through Steam" to sign in to your Steam account and receive your free Steam code for Gurumin!
Please note: Mastiff WILL NOT keep your Steam login information or use your profile data for any purpose other than checking for Gurumin Steam key elegibility.


Thank you all who participated and made this possible! And if you enjoy the game, please consider telling your friends about Gurumin. We need and appreciate your support!  


Happy Adventuring!

- Mastiff

notes.title: Multi-Purpose Achievements Revealed!
notes.notes:
Happy Friday, all! 

We're just a few days out from launch, and it's time to shift things into high-gear!

We recently revealed that Gurumin will include a cool Steam-exclusive feature that we have dubbed  "Multi-Purpose Achievements."

"What are 'Multi-Purpose Achievements'," you ask? 

Well simply put, Gurumin has 9 super-secret achievements that, once unlocked, will award you with a wallpaper you can use to decorate your desktop with. Each of these wallpapers features gorgeous hand-drawn artwork by developer, Nihon Falcom.

Players can change their PC's desktop wallpaper from within the game. It's easy as pie and sweet as shortcake! Check out the gif below to see how these "Multi-purpose Achievement" wallpapers work.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/6i6KQ9Y.gif[/img]

[img]http://i.imgur.com/1S0xpzp.png[/img]

Pretty awesome, 'eh?

Please help us spread the news about Gurumin's upcoming March 30 release by sharing the steam store page URL with your Twitter followers, posting it to your Facebook wall, sending telegraphs, smoke signals, carrier pigeon...whatever! :D

Thanks all, and have a splendid weekend!
